description: Requalify INTEIRO-RFC-001 P0 in technical-autonomous mode on the current source: fix the post-action geometry race behind the freeze-4 Linux task-05 finding, bind each of the 58 requirements to its executed proof, restore the CI trigger-to-profile workflow additively, measure end-to-end lint, prove executor isolation from protected references and the attestor key, and qualify the same source on Windows and Linux, and clear the dependency advisories published after freeze 4 under the unchanged zero-tolerance audit policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Post-action geometry evidence never re-resolves a target that the action itself renamed or removed; the deterministic interleaving that reproduced the task-05 finding passes, and ambiguous matches remain strict-mode errors.

Each of the 58 requirement rows resolves to its own executed cases, qualification checks and core gates; missing proof, skipped-only cases, hash divergence, excluded applicability and unproven aggregates block acceptance.

A requirement row is accepted only with an executed, passing case of its own; a passing aggregate check or gate adds scope but never accepts a row alone, and the four rows that carried only aggregates (WP-16, DoD-02, DoD-04, DoD-11) are bound to real cases.

The pattern coverage map (41 patterns, every state, viewport, theme, density, content, direction, zoom, keyboard and controlled negative) is cross-referenced with executed Playwright and story cases: each declared dimension resolves to a named passing case, and each N/A carries a justification.
The final audit signs the per-requirement index and the release gate re-derives it before accepting any row; the core evidence envelope inteiro-evidence/v1.1 is accepted.
The CI workflow maps pull request, main and schedule to the pr, main and nightly profiles without --changed, while the standardized ci.yml stays unchanged.
Static lint performance is measured end to end over 1,000 files on disk and RFC §19 targets are recorded as non-blocking.
The isolated implementation worker cannot write protected references and cannot reach the technical attestor key.
Existing promoted references, technical attestations, policies and the historical specification remain unchanged.

npm audit reports zero advisories under the unchanged zero-tolerance policy: Style Dictionary, the only path to the unfixed deepmerge advisory, is replaced by an in-repo Android color generator whose output is byte-identical for every opaque color and preserves alpha for translucent ones, and minimatch, glob and follow-redirects resolve to patched releases.

The RFC §19 visual changed-subset target is measured by repeated runs restricted to the routes selected by the PR impact contract for a changed shared file, and recorded as non-blocking with its synthetic method and limitation.
